fusions.name: Eightfold Reach
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands spread apart, each dealing 9 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Final Coil
fusions.desc: Winds a strand around a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 24 damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of strands fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Boneless Give
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (48% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
